name: Berovo in a day
description_md:
This one day city sightseeing walk covers 8.4 km of walking between stops anchored in Berovo. The full day takes about 6.5 hours, which includes visit time at each stop.

The route features four sightseeing stops across the city. Walkers spend a full day exploring the main sights of Berovo.
